text_block_list.text:
Though Mayano Top Gun gave it everything 
she had, she lost the showdown against 
Narita Brian.

However, having enjoyed the contest from 
the bottom of her heart, she couldn't stop 
the thrill from surging.

And Mayano Top Gun, realizing that Narita 
Brian was still not satisfied—

She resolves to run in the Hanshin 
Daishoten to once again enjoy a thrilling 
contest against her.
